name: pumpkin-clean
prompt: Transparent game sprite sheet for the existing hand painted cartoon Halloween side scroller. Strong dark outlines, detailed soft shading, exact existing character identities and colors. Real transparent alpha between sprites, no backdrop color, no ground shadows, no labels, no grid lines. Generous empty gutters. EDIT the reference pumpkin headed zombie jester atlas. EXACTLY 24 full sprites, 4 columns by 6 rows. Same orange and purple suit, white gloves, curled purple boots, hat and pumpkin AS THE HEAD. Keep the cyan carved eyes and mouth with a yellow inner core. REMOVE EVERY external flame, energy orb, smoke ribbon, sparkle, projectile and muzzle effect from EVERY cel. Nothing may extend from the mouth except the pumpkin itself. Row1-2 eight leftward walking poses; row3 four anticipation poses crouching and inflating the cheeks; row4 four release poses with an open carved mouth facing LEFT, mouth held at a steady point, NO expelled object or energy; row5 four recovery poses; row6 four cartoon fall/defeat poses. No aura surrounding the character. Clean isolated body art only, including during release. Keep identical character scale in all cells; do not shrink a pose to make room for an attack effect.

name: witch-ground
prompt: Transparent game sprite sheet for the existing hand painted cartoon Halloween side scroller. Strong dark outlines, detailed soft shading, exact existing character identities and colors. Real transparent alpha between sprites, no backdrop color, no ground shadows, no labels, no grid lines. Generous empty gutters. Use the witch in the reference as identity reference. Create EXACTLY 24 ground witch sprites, 4 columns by 6 rows. SAME witch, green face, purple robe and hat with buckle, large white hair, gold skull brooch, brown wand. Facing LEFT in every cel. Uniform head width and full standing height across all rows, same baseline. NO magic, light burst, sparkles, ribbons, projectiles, floating candies or glow drawn on or beyond the wand. Just a bare wooden wand, tip visible and clean. Rows: row1 four walking/stationary poses with alternating steps. Row2 four windup poses raising then aiming bare wand. Row3 four release/recovery poses: first cel fully extends wand horizontally left, bare tip at the same place through first three cels, fourth lowers it slightly. Row4 four HIT REACTION poses: flinch back, wince with eyes squeezed shut, clutch hurt shoulder, regain balance, all whole bodies. Row5 four absorption preparation poses holding a small orange pumpkin vessel at waist, reaching toward a distant candy (do not draw that candy). Row6 four absorption/release gestures with the same vessel; no candy or magical energy baked into the image. Same proportions, no character growth between walking, firing, hit or absorption.

name: witch-air
prompt: Transparent game sprite sheet for the existing hand painted cartoon Halloween side scroller. Strong dark outlines, detailed soft shading, exact existing character identities and colors. Real transparent alpha between sprites, no backdrop color, no ground shadows, no labels, no grid lines. Generous empty gutters. Use the flying witch on a broom in the reference as identity reference. EXACTLY 24 full witch AND broom sprites, 4 columns by 6 rows. Green face, purple robe/hat with gold buckle, white hair, skull brooch, brown bare wand, broom straw orange. Facing LEFT throughout. All cels use the SAME character scale and head width, baseline at lowest boot/broom. NO magic, beams, glows, circles, trails, floating candy or projectiles drawn onto the body or wand. Row1 four hovering/cruising poses, hair and robe billowing. Row2 four cast preparation poses, bare wand raises then points down-left. Keep entire broom in every cell and stable body scale.

name: spell-fx
prompt: Transparent game sprite sheet for the existing hand painted cartoon Halloween side scroller. Strong dark outlines, detailed soft shading, exact existing character identities and colors. Real transparent alpha between sprites, no backdrop color, no ground shadows, no labels, no grid lines. Generous empty gutters. Generate only separate magical EFFECTS, no characters. EXACTLY 24 effects, four columns by six rows. Rows1-2: eight animation phases of a LEFTWARD traveling cyan spectral flame ball, warm tiny yellow core, curling turquoise blue flame tongues trailing RIGHT. Like a small swirling blue fireball, never a ghost face or skull, no body; bright core at x80 of each 256 cell, visual tail extends right, core stable. Row3: four phases of a small round cyan/yellow emission flash, no long beam. Row4: four LEFTWARD witch ray phases: long magenta violet streak with white-pink pointed head at LEFT and flowing thin purple brush tails RIGHT, no round aura, no square glow. name: run-adults
prompt: Transparent game sprite sheet for the existing hand painted cartoon Halloween side scroller. Strong dark outlines, detailed soft shading, exact existing character identities and colors. Real transparent alpha between sprites, no backdrop color, no ground shadows, no labels, no grid lines. Generous empty gutters. EDIT/REBUILD the running sheet using both reference characters as exact identity references. EXACTLY 16 sprites in FOUR columns by FOUR rows. Top TWO rows = eight sequential full body RUN frames of plump mustached baker with brown flat cap, blue vest, white apron and bread basket. Bottom TWO rows = eight sequential full body RUN frames of woman with brown hair in a bun, rose dress, white apron, green scarf and grocery basket. Both characters flee to the LEFT. A genuine eight pose leftward RUN cycle, NOT four poses played backwards: 0 left leg reaching forward/heel contact, right leg extended back; 1 weight down on left leg with opposite knee folding; 2 left leg passing underneath the hips, right knee ahead; 3 flight with right knee rising; 4 RIGHT leg reaching forward/heel contact and LEFT leg extended back (the opposite of pose 0); 5 weight down on right leg, left knee folding; 6 right leg passing underneath hips, left knee ahead; 7 flight with left knee rising into pose 0. All eight poses of each character use same side view facing left. Head can be turned slightly back on the second character but keep gaze stable across the gait. Preserve body/head size and clothing from reference. No duplicated first-half cycle, no frozen legs, no extra limbs, no cropped shoes. Keep the two character designs separate in their two-row sections.
